messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
**Best months to visit Hawaii (overall)**  
| Season | Months | Why it’s great |
|--------|--------|----------------|
| **Late Spring / Early Summer** | **April – June** | Warm, sunny days (highs 80–85 °F / 27–29 °C) with light showers. Crowds are still manageable, and prices are lower than peak summer. |
| **Early Fall** | **September – November** | Similar pleasant weather, but after the July‑August peak. Surf conditions improve, and you’ll see fewer tourists. |

### Quick Weather Snapshot (Honolulu, Oʻahu)

| Month | Avg High | Avg Low | Avg Rainfall |
|-------|----------|---------|--------------|
| April | 81 °F (27 °C) | 66 °F (19 °C) | 1.8 in (46 mm) |
| May | 83 °F (28 °C) | 67 °F (19 °C) | 1.5 in (38 mm) |
| June | 84 °F (29 °C) | 68 °F (20 °C) | 1.0 in (25 mm) |
| July | 86 °F (30 °C) | 70 °F (21 °C) | 1.2 in (30 mm) |
| August | 87 °F (31 °C) | 71 °F (22 °C) | 1.3 in (33 mm) |
| September | 86 °F (30 °C) | 70 °F (21 °C) | 1.0 in (25 mm) |
| October | 84 °F (29 °C) | 68 °F (20 °C) | 1.4 in (36 mm) |
| November | 82 °F (28 °C) | 66 °F (19 °C) | 1.7 in (43 mm) |

> *Note:* These averages come from NOAA’s climate normals for Honolulu. Other islands (Maui, Kauai, Big Island) have similar patterns, though rainfall can vary by micro‑climate.

### Things to Consider

| Interest | Best Time |
|----------|-----------|
| **Surfing (big waves)** | Winter (December–February) |
| **Whale Watching** | December–January |
| **Hiking & Outdoor Activities** | Late spring/early fall (April–June, September–November) |
| **Budget Travel** | Shoulder seasons (April–June, September–November) |
| **Crowd Avoidance** | Early spring (March–April) or late fall (October–November) |

### Bottom Line

If you’re looking for a balance of warm, dry weather, reasonable crowds, and good prices, **late spring (April–June)** and **early fall (September–November)** are your sweet spots. If you’re chasing specific seasonal events—like humpback whales or big‑wave surfing—you’ll want to plan around those windows instead.
